scientific_question: Within Lepidoptera, does response-blind ecological similarity predict greater cross-species spatial-genetic congruence beyond geographic sampling geometry?

pairwise_transfer_surface.alignment: nearest source edge midpoint for each target edge, retaining only target edges whose nearest source edge midpoint is <=500 km
pairwise_transfer_surface.cap_sampling: response-blind deterministic pair-specific sampling without replacement
pairwise_transfer_surface.pair_transfer_congruence: Pearson correlation between aligned source and target post-IBD edge-response values

trait_similarity.composite: mean of the four frozen [0,1] axis similarities

geometry_control.method: pooled target-fixed-effect residualization of trait similarity before response scoring
geometry_control.standardization: center within target, then population-standardize each geometry covariate across all target-source pairs

primary_statistic.per_target: Pearson correlation across supported sources between geometry-residualized trait similarity and pairwise transfer congruence
primary_statistic.panel: arithmetic mean of finite per-target correlations

inference.method: worst-case one-sided upper-tail Monte Carlo envelope over independent nuisance-null reference distributions
inference.p_value: maximum of the +1 corrected upper-tail Monte Carlo p-values from the private and geometry-confounded reference cells

qualification_gates.private_type1: Wilson 95% upper bound of p<=0.05 rejection rate <=0.10
qualification_gates.geometry_trap_type1: Wilson 95% upper bound of p<=0.05 rejection rate <=0.10
qualification_gates.positive_power: Wilson 95% lower bound of p<=0.05 rejection rate >=0.80

development_disclosure.note: The retired v0.1 worlds showed centered-bootstrap geometry-trap leakage. Separate exploratory calculations on that already-spent namespace motivated target-level correlation and nuisance-null envelope calibration. No v0.2 reference or evaluation seed is shared with v0.1.

stopping_rules: Do not alter the v0.2 estimator, alignment cap, nuisance family, synthetic amplitudes, alpha, or gates after any v0.2 reference/evaluation statistic is inspected.
If any v0.2 gate fails, retire v0.2; any successor must use a new name and fully disjoint seed namespaces.
Do not compute the new 339-species empirical genetic response before v0.2 passes all three gates.
